WITH transaction_sentiment AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg AS transaction_reference,
    t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
    AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
order_type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    AVG(avg_short_interest_days_to_cover) AS order_type_avg_short_interest
  FROM transaction_sentiment
  GROUP BY order_type_mix
)
SELECT
  ts.transaction_reference,
  ts.order_type_mix,
  ts.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
  ts.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  ts.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover / ota.order_type_avg_short_interest
    AS short_interest_ratio_to_order_type_average
FROM transaction_sentiment AS ts
LEFT JOIN order_type_averages AS ota
  ON ota.order_type_mix = ts.order_type_mix
ORDER BY
  short_interest_ratio_to_order_type_average IS NULL,
  short_interest_ratio_to_order_type_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The comparison average is the unweighted average of each matching transaction's average short interest, grouped by order type mix; transactions with no short-interest values have a NULL average and do not contribute.
